subject: Five Phoenix accounts to review for Alliance Commercial Cleaning Services
initial_email:
Hi Alliance Commercial Cleaning Services team,

Hey, this is Brett with BMC Service Network. We research local commercial accounts so service businesses can spend less time building lists and more time having useful conversations.

Your site lists professional offices, retail stores and fitness studios across Greater Phoenix.

I put together five Phoenix businesses to review against that scope. For example, Tiffany & Bosco Phoenix has a published local contact route; the brief explains the facility fit and who to ask about vendor onboarding. Each entry includes its business website and a suggested first conversation.

You can keep the five free, as a PDF and an online brief. If the fit is useful, $499 buys 100 total, including those five. These are researched prospects—not businesses that requested a quote—and sales are not guaranteed.

[Button: View my five Phoenix prospects]

Would a different facility type be more useful? Reply with the work you want more of.

Brett
BMC Service Network
contact@bmcservicenetwork.com

sample.fit_reason: Official Phoenix office page lists Central Arts Plaza, 1850 North Central Avenue, 24th floor, Phoenix AZ 85004 and a general office phone. Ask office administration whether suite cleaning is tenant-controlled or part of building management, and what confidentiality and access rules apply. sample.sales_angle: Call the general office line and ask who manages suite-cleaning vendors. Confirm whether the firm or building buys the service before offering a walkthrough; do not use legal intake or attorney contact forms.
